system.description:
Quick-Draw. If you're using a ranged weapon when a Combat Encounter starts, you may make a Strike with it after Combat States are set and before the first Combat Round.

Too Many Doughnuts (Flaw). Your Move Distance is 5 ft lower, whatever your Speed.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.93

automation.note: At the start of a Combat Encounter, if you're using a ranged weapon, make one Strike with it after Combat States are set and before Combat Round 1.

system.flawSummary: Your Move Distance is 5 ft lower, whatever your Speed.
system.flawDescription: Your Move Distance is 5 ft lower, whatever your Speed.

flawAutomation.note: Reduce your Move Distance by 5 ft at every Speed: Slow 15 ft, Average 25 ft, Fast 35 ft.
